title: Canonical geometric pullback compositor and square with the scalar functor interface exposed
statement: For a commutative condensed coefficient ring R, define scalarPullbackComposition R h k : L R (h ≫ k) ≅ L R k ⋙ L R h to be leftDerivedUpperStarComp R h k with the typed alias L of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. For a chosen Cartesian square (a,f,c,f′) [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], define scalarPullbackSquare R sq : L R c ⋙ L R f′ ≅ L R f ⋙ L R a by composing the inverse (f′,c) compositor, the equality transport from the square, and the (a,f) compositor. Unfolding L gives exactly condensedAmbientPullbackComparison R sq of [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. These definitions make no comparison choice.
